name: Ghost Walk

modifiers.note: Fly Speed 10 feet; you can hover
You can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain; you take 1d10 Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object

desc: Phantom: a spectral form for 10 minutes — Fly Speed 10 ft. (hover), attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and you can move through creatures and objects. Ends early if you dismiss it (no action) or are Incapacitated.
